This is essentially computer fraud / theft using computer. In Chinese criminal law, relevant offenses: "非法获取计算机信息系统数据、非法控制计算机信息系统" (i.e., illegal access, illegal acquisition of computer information system data) or "破坏计算机信息系统罪" (damage). Also "诈骗" maybe? But they are stealing money via hacking, which is "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (theft of computer data) or "盗窃" (theft) but with computer. In Chinese case law, they often charge "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (illegal acquisition of computer information system data) and "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" for teaching others. However examples: earlier they had "持有、使用假币;盗窃" for similar. For hacking, they used "破坏计算机信息系统" for modifying data. Here they are using fiddler to intercept and withdraw money, i.e., illegal acquisition of computer information system data and illegal use of computer to commit theft. Could be "盗窃罪" (theft) but also "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪". The examples: For case with fake website used for fraud, they gave "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具". For case with modifying recharge data, they gave "破坏计算机信息系统". For case with using fake website to facilitate fraud, they gave "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具". For case with using fiddler to steal money, they are both stealing and providing method. So likely crimes: "盗窃罪" (theft) and "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (helping others commit computer crime) or "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪". The description: "向他人传授犯罪方法" - that is "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". In Chinese law, article 287-2? Actually "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (Article 293 of Criminal Law). So answer likely: "盗窃;帮助信息网络犯罪活动". Let's see examples: In earlier example with "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具" they gave that as answer. For teaching others to hack, they used that. So we should include that. Also the primary theft: "盗窃". So final answer: [罪名]盗窃;帮助信息网络犯罪活动<eoa>
